info.title: Get Stoopy — proposed marketplace API
info.description: PHASE 1 DESIGN ONLY. No endpoint is implemented or connected. Contract validation is not an application/security test. All authorization, idempotency and provider requirements are mandatory implementation gates. No live server is declared.
